subject: maths
question: A trader sells one brand of coffee (X) at 120 per kg, incurring a 20% loss. He also sells another brand (Y) at 300 per kg, incurring a 25% profit. If he mixes the two brands in equal proportions and sells the mixture at 200 per kg, what is his overall profit or loss percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Brand X SP = 120 (20% loss)

Brand Y SP = 300 (25% profit)

Mixture ratio = 1 : 1

Mixture SP = 200 per kg

**Formula used:**

CP = SP ÷ (1 ± profit/loss %)

Overall % = (SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100
